sections.title: 5. P09.5: MSI invariant model and runbook
sections.text:
P09.9 current contract after owner D132: reconcile first-party Laravel13-only platform declarations and verify four fresh PHP8.4/8.5 × Laravel13 × SQLite/PG rows with pinned Pest5.2.1/PHPUnit13.3.4/Infection0.35.6. Source/tool/lock hashes, real Pest/coverage XML/JUnit, uncovered/timeout/exit137 controls and 2h+2h budgets remain. P09.5 is not executed in this scope.

P09.5 creates locked runner, exhaustive zones, self-tests, CI shards; it does not own unbounded behavior test improvements. P09.12 improves security95; P09.13 messaging90; P09.14 other75. Exact inventory of every committed packages/*/src and products/flex-crm/src PHP file; unmatched/multiply assigned file RED. Deterministic longest-path precedence: security packages/{access,access-azguard,tenancy,tools,webhooks}, core/{Context,Tenancy,Database,Data}, core/Modules/Internal/Gate and operations/Authorization. Messaging core/Messaging, remaining operations, packages/{wakeup,workflow,tasks-workflow,transfer}; other all remaining source. Empty configured production path fails inventory and is corrected against actual source, never silently omitted.

Acceptance is PER PACKAGE-FRAGMENT (package × zone), not pooled zone MSI. Every behavioral fragment must generate >0 valid mutants and achieve its own 95/90/75%; aggregates are diagnostics only. Source-only declaration file may have zero mutants only if PHPParser AST proves all nodes are interfaces/abstract declarations/enums or immutable DTO storage with no mutatable expressions/branches; exact path+source hash+AST reason is in zero-ledger. A whole fragment may be declaration-only (e.g. thin bridge/contracts) only if EVERY file meets that predicate and exclusion ledger is explicitly confirmed by P09.8; classify N/A-declaration, never numeric MSI100/GREEN, still run API/PHPStan/schema tests. One behavior file with zero generated/valid mutants makes fragment RED. Arbitrary zero-file reason is insufficient. All 3 zone inventories must have actual behavioral fragments; whole empty zone RED.

Runner initial green SQLite+required PG tests produce fresh XML+JUnit, source/test/config/tool/lock hashes bound to each package sandbox. PG-only method coverage cannot be replaced with SQLite. Generate fragment Infection config in build/quality, --with-uncovered --with-timeouts --threads=1. Strict score =100*killed-by-tests/valid; timeouts, escaped, uncovered are denominator members, timeouts never killed. No process errors count as killed. Syntax-invalid exclusion needs raw mutant source + actual PHP syntax-check failing at its mutant location. Compile-invalid additionally needs deterministic standalone reproduction proving original loads, mutant load fails due changed declaration; type assertion/test exception is a behavioral result, not compile invalid. Unknown error/DB/adapter/coverage/OOM infrastructure is blocking. Preserve raw process/exit/stdout/stderr and exact report field classification.

Concrete self-tests from locked Infection spike logs: parse error mutant (php -l fails, excluded syntax); duplicate/redeclared method incompatible signature (php -l may pass, isolated load deterministically fails, excluded compile only with proof); PHPUnit discovery/bootstrap error, missing Pest executable, missing XML/JUnit, PDO connection-refused, process exit137/OOM and unrecognized JSON status (infrastructure RED); PHPUnit assertion failure (killed); time limit (timeout valid, not killed); malformed/unreadable report, missing PG coverage, stale source/test/lock and fragment omission (RED). Compare actual locked log schema to parser fixtures; --self-test proves parser only, zone runs prove metrics. Boundary fixtures 94.99/95 and 89.99/90.

Equivalent ledger exact mutant+source/hash+reason/replay needs independent confirmation. Equivalent exclusions ceiling <=5% of pre-equivalence valid generated mutants IN EACH fragment (no minimum-count rounding allowance), also <=5% globally; >ceiling RED, no agent waiver. This cap is a new stricter design rule, requires independent design review before admission. Parse/compile exclusions are reported separately and individually reproduced, cannot be renamed equivalent or silently erase a fragment. P09.8 audits all exception hashes/replay and declaration classification, confirms cap and raw report arithmetic. Any exclusion after source change expires.

CI materializes one job per package-fragment with min threshold; max-parallel=4, threads=1; separate checkout+coverage+unique *_test DB per worker, root coverage sequential. Job timeout-minutes=60, per-mutant process timeout=10s (timeouts remain valid), initial suite timeout=600s; measured receipts show duration. Every zone repair item budget two 4h rounds, then blocked with survivors; no unbounded test rewrite. --zone security|messaging|other selects all that zone's fragments and preserves strict inventory; --all combines fresh matching receipts and must refuse gaps/stale/tool changes. Fixed scripts/mutation-check.sh --all remains separate. P09.7 full aggregate final pass once; CI per-fragment shards recreate measurements, not reuse local success blindly.

Negative zone fixtures deliberately change each authorizer/activation path to other or omit it: --inventory --check must exit1 and name the file. Add Data full-prefix plus exact activation contract before other; nonbehavioral declarations retain existing AST/hash rules.

G5 P09.13 additionally owns the three exact Transfer DoD behavioral checks beyond MSI. SqlTransferExecutorTest.php already contains valid cross-job dedup and partial-savepoint behavior; lexical absence is not a missing test. New ReleaseResumeTest.php: source returns row1 then remaining=true/cursor ordinal1/checkpoint_seq1; destroy first executor and instantiate a new one against same PG state, use StepToken(checkpointSequence=1,epoch=1,same hashes), source must be read AFTER persisted ordinal1 and yield row2/remaining=false; observe completed checkpoint_seq2, both distinct row records/refs, and no second target apply for committed row1. Split tree/commit delivery fields cannot be final until D122 accepted and matching sealed result proven. Operator UNASSIGNED until owner; publication status=pending-owner-grant. D123 channel classification governs private packet storage; no upload disclosure inferred. No qualification/hosted cycle: P09.6 exporter smoke → P09.16 local workflow/packet builder+tests → final committed product snapshot → P09.7 current rc/all proofs plus operator_packet.py --candidate --evidence --output build/release/operator-packet.json → exact owner-operated, runtime owner_gate P09.17 push/dispatch → P09.8 read-only review.
